facts.fact: The Electoral Commission of South Africa promulgated the Electoral Code of Conduct Countering Disinformation on 4 September 2026 under section 88(a) of the Municipal Electoral Act, in force immediately until the election results, requiring parties and candidates to label AI-generated content clearly, with the Electoral Code of Conduct's sanctions.
facts.system: Electoral Code of Conduct Countering Disinformation in the Local Government Elections

ZAF.note: Nothing on local government offices' connection.
The Code says it protects lawful criticism and debate; no dated criticism, cut or punishment is stated.
